rt:model.rt:sub: Sub ValCalc() If pv != nothing Then ErrAa = False If (Value_AZ == -9999) || (Value_AZ >= pv.RangeHigh) || (Value_AZ <= pv.RangeLow) Then ErrAa = True End If FBar = Lt() If (pv.Quality == 0) && !ErrAa Then FColor = Color_Inval ElseIf (Value_AZ != -9999) && (pv.Value <= Value_AZ) Then FColor = Color_ANA_HI_A ElseIf (Value_PZ != -9999) && (pv.Value <= Value_PZ) Then FColor = Color_ANA_HI_P Else FColor = Color_ANA_GOOD End If End If End Sub

Function Lt() As Float 'Вычисление уровней по формулам If pv == Nothing Then Lt = 1 Exit Function End If
Dim Am As Double Dim At As Double Dim A0 As Double Dim Aa As Double Am = pv.RangeHigh At = pv.Value A0 = pv.RangeLow If (Value_AZ == -9999) Then Aa = A0 Else Aa = Value_AZ End If
If (At >= Aa) Then Lt = 0.9 - Log10(1 + 500*(At - Aa)/(Am - Aa)) / 3.0 Else Lt = 0.9 + Log10(1 + 500*(Aa - At)/(Aa - A0)) / 27.0 End If End Function
rt:model.rt:event: Set pv = ANA(PointID) If pv == Nothing Then FColor = Color_ANA_ER_LINK End If

rect.rt:event: If pv == nothing Then NoLink(PointID) ElseIf ErrAa Then ShowWarning("Значение аварийной уставки\nвыходит за границы сигнала!", 10) Else Call_Win ("ws_ANA_NB", pv.PVId + "|-1") End If

If pv == nothing Then NoLink(PointID) ElseIf ErrAa Then ShowWarning("Значение аварийной уставки\nвыходит за границы сигнала!", 10) Else LoadPopUpMenu(pv.PVId + "|ANAi|ws_ANA_NB " + pv.PVId + "|-1") End If
